subject.title: Discord leaks internal tool-call traces (NO_REPLY, commentary, to=functions) to channel

question: What security boundary should OpenClaw enforce for Discord/internal envelope-shaped output before this issue can close?
rationale: Source inspection shows a remaining sanitizer gap, but the fix can suppress legitimate Discord markdown or JSON examples and overlaps broader explicit-send policy decisions.

options.title: Approve Narrow Envelope Sanitizer
options.body: Add a bounded shared or Discord sanitizer for the reported envelope shapes, with tests proving both stripping and legitimate JSON/code preservation.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Delivery Policy
options.body: Treat this as a subset of the broader text-between-tools/explicit-send decision tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/25592 and keep this issue linked until that policy lands.

options.title: Require Fresh Live Repro First
options.body: Pause implementation until a maintainer or reporter provides a current live Discord transcript proving the exact remaining envelope variants still leak.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Envelope Sanitizer
recommendation.body: Add a bounded shared or Discord sanitizer for the reported envelope shapes, with tests proving both stripping and legitimate JSON/code preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent shared outbound and sanitizer-adjacent history makes this the best available routing owner for the security/product boundary choice.
